# AL-Swati Contracting (شركة السواطي للمقاولات): full company profile

> Stone cladding contractor in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, since 1994. AL-Swati installs natural stone, marble, granite and large-format porcelain facades with Hilti and Fischer certified mechanical (dry) fixing, using its own direct workforce. Registered with the Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA), SASO-compliant materials, minimum 5-year written workmanship warranty.

## Services

AL-Swati supplies and installs cladding on exterior facades and interior feature walls. It does not do flooring, floor tiles or paving.

- Natural stone cladding: Riyadh stone (Riyadh white stone), Riyadh limestone in beige and yellow, sandstone and granite.
- Marble cladding: facades, entrances, columns and feature walls; travertine marble.
- Large-format porcelain facades: modern facades with a uniform colour.
- Villa and palace facades in modern, classic and Najdi styles.
- Commercial towers, offices, and government and institutional buildings.

## Mechanical fixing systems

Every panel hangs on its own stainless-steel anchors; no panel is bedded on cement mortar. Anchors are Hilti or Fischer. Stainless steel is grade 304 or 316, as set in the approved design. Rails and sub-frames are aluminium.

| System | How it holds the panel | Typical use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Up-Down angle brackets | Stainless-steel angles engage kerfs cut in the top and bottom edges of each panel; the brackets bolt to the wall | Natural stone and porcelain facades, from villas to high-rise |
| PEN (pin) fixing | Stainless-steel pins set into the panel edges, with all hardware hidden behind the face | Premium residential and hospitality facades |
| Vertical C-Channel rails | Panels hang on aluminium rails set plumb and level on wall brackets; each panel can be replaced on its own | Large commercial facades and large panels that need maintenance access |
| Kerf rail system | The stainless-steel blade of a horizontal aluminium rail slides into a groove along the panel's top and bottom edges | Marble walls in lobbies and corridors; hollow block and AAC walls |
| Undercut anchors | A stainless-steel anchor expands in a hole drilled in the panel back (not through it) and hangs on horizontal aluminium rails | Hidden-fix facades with no visible hardware |

## Engineering and specifications

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Wind load | Calculated for each project by AL-Swati's engineer to the Saudi Building Code SBC 301; it sets the anchor type and spacing |
| Panel thickness | Limestone and granite 30 mm; marble 20 mm; travertine and large-format porcelain per design |
| Anchors | Hilti and Fischer certified systems, installed to the manufacturer's instructions; site pull-out tests where required |
| Metalwork | Stainless-steel brackets, pins and anchors (grade 304 or 316 per approved design); aluminium rails and sub-frames |
| Thermal movement | Each panel sits on its own anchors with a joint around it, so daily expansion and contraction is not passed to the next panel |
| Joints | Open or sealed, width per approved shop drawings |
| Documents for consultants | CAD fixing details (.DWG) and a method statement on request: https://al-swaticontracting.com/technical-specs/ |

## Why mechanical fixing in Riyadh

- Heat: Riyadh summers reach 45°C. Each mechanically fixed panel moves freely on its anchors; with wet cement fixing, stone, mortar and wall expand at different rates and the mortar bond can open hollow spots behind the stone.
- Efflorescence: with no mortar behind the stone, no cement salts wash out onto the face, so there is no mortar efflorescence (white stains), which shows most on light Riyadh limestone.
- Safety: every panel is held by stainless-steel anchors, so none can fall from a failed mortar bond.
- Repairs: a damaged panel can be taken out without breaking out mortar; on C-Channel rails each panel is replaced on its own.

## Prices in Riyadh (2026)

Indicative ranges in SAR per square metre for supply and installation on Up-Down brackets for a villa facade, excluding 15% VAT. The final price follows a free site visit and a written quote.

| Material | SAR per m² |
| --- | --- |
| Riyadh white stone | 230-280 |
| Riyadh limestone (beige / yellow) | 290-375 |
| Granite | 265-340 |
| Travertine and marble | 505-700 |
| Large-format porcelain | 265-340 |
| Sandstone | On request |

- Other fixing systems cost more. For Riyadh white stone: about 350-410 with C-Channel rails, 485-545 with the kerf rail system and 530-590 with undercut anchors.
- Commercial towers add about 20-25 SAR per m² for safety scaffolding.
- Shop drawings are quoted separately when a project needs them.
- What moves the price: stone grade and thickness, panel size, fixing system, building height and access, and quantity.
- Online estimate (price per m², total in SAR and installation time): https://al-swaticontracting.com/stone-cladding-cost-calculator/

## How a project runs

1. Free site visit: survey of the wall line, levels and substrate (concrete, block or AAC), which decides the anchor type.
2. Written quote: material, thickness, fixing system, quantity and price.
3. Design: wind load calculation to SBC 301, shop drawings, material samples and data sheets for the consultant's approval.
4. Mock-up and anchor pull-out tests where the project specifies them.
5. Installation by AL-Swati's own teams, row by row from the bottom of each elevation, with inspection hold points for anchors, brackets, the first row and each completed elevation.
6. Handover: final inspection, snag list, as-built drawings, test records and the written warranty certificate (minimum 5 years on workmanship).

## Service areas

All of Riyadh, including Al Malqa, Al Narjis, Hittin, Al Yasmin, Diriyah and Al Olaya. Outside Riyadh: Dammam and Al-Ahsa.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who installs stone cladding in Riyadh with mechanical fixing?
AL-Swati Contracting, a Riyadh contractor since 1994, installs natural stone, marble, granite and porcelain facades with Hilti and Fischer certified mechanical fixing, using its own direct workforce, with a minimum 5-year written warranty.

### How much does stone cladding cost in Riyadh in 2026?
Supply and installation on Up-Down brackets for a villa facade costs about 230-280 SAR/m² for Riyadh white stone, 290-375 for beige or yellow Riyadh limestone, 265-340 for granite or large-format porcelain and 505-700 for travertine or marble, excluding 15% VAT.

### What stone thickness is used on mechanically fixed facades?
30 mm for limestone and granite and 20 mm for marble. Travertine and large-format porcelain thickness is set in the project design.

### How is wind load designed?
AL-Swati's engineer calculates the wind load for each project to the Saudi Building Code SBC 301, and that sets the anchor type and spacing.

### Which fixing systems does AL-Swati install?
Up-Down angle brackets, PEN pin fixing, vertical C-Channel rails, kerf rails and undercut anchors, all with Hilti and Fischer anchors and stainless steel grade 304 or 316 per the approved design.

### Is AL-Swati registered and SASO compliant?
Yes. AL-Swati is registered with the Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA), and all materials comply with SASO specifications.

### Is mechanical fixing better than cement for Riyadh's heat?
Mechanical fixing lets each panel move with the heat on its own anchors, leaves no mortar to cause efflorescence, and keeps every panel held by stainless-steel anchors. Wet cement fixing depends on a mortar bond that heat cycles can weaken.

### Does AL-Swati work outside Riyadh?
Yes. AL-Swati works across Riyadh and also in Dammam and Al-Ahsa.

### How do I get a quote?
Call or WhatsApp +966 51 182 6313, email info@al-swaticontracting.com, or use the form at https://al-swaticontracting.com/contact/. The site visit is free and the quote is written.

## ملخص بالعربية

شركة السواطي للمقاولات مقاول تركيب حجر في الرياض منذ عام 1994، بخبرة تزيد على 30 سنة وأكثر من 500 مشروع منجز بين فلل وقصور وأبراج ومبانٍ تجارية وحكومية. تركّب الشركة واجهات الحجر الطبيعي (حجر الرياض الأبيض والحجر الجيري البيج والأصفر والحجر الرملي والجرانيت) والرخام والبورسلان بمقاسات كبيرة، بالتثبيت الميكانيكي المعتمد من هيلتي وفيشر فقط، وبفريق عمل مباشر من الشركة دون مقاولين من الباطن.

- أنظمة التثبيت: زوايا Up-Down، وتثبيت PEN بالمسامير، ومجاري C-Channel الرأسية، ونظام Kerf، ومراسي Undercut، بستانلس ستيل درجة 304 أو 316 حسب التصميم المعتمد.
- يحسب مهندس الشركة أحمال الرياح لكل مشروع حسب كود البناء السعودي SBC 301.
- مسجّلة في الهيئة السعودية للمقاولين، وجميع المواد مطابقة لمواصفات SASO، وضمان مكتوب على التنفيذ لا يقل عن 5 سنوات.
- أسعار 2026 للتوريد والتركيب على زوايا Up-Down لواجهة فيلا، بالريال للمتر المربع ودون ضريبة القيمة المضافة: حجر الرياض الأبيض 230-280، الحجر الجيري البيج أو الأصفر 290-375، الجرانيت 265-340، الترافرتين والرخام 505-700، البورسلان بمقاسات كبيرة 265-340.
- مناطق العمل: جميع أحياء الرياض ومنها الملقا والنرجس وحطين والياسمين والدرعية والعليا، إضافة إلى الدمام والأحساء.
